title: Coin Change
description: You are given an integer array `coins` representing coins of different denominations and an integer `amount` representing a total amount of money. Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If that amount of money cannot be made up, return `-1`.

hints.content: Define dp[i] as the minimum coins needed to make amount i.
Initialize dp array of size amount + 1 filled with Infinity, with dp[0] = 0.
For each coin: for i from coin to amount: dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1).

solution.explanation:
Bottom-up dynamic programming. dp[i] computes fewest coins to make amount i.
Time Complexity: O(amount * len(coins))
Space Complexity: O(amount)
